cues.text: Deep underwater. Light ripples on the surface far above.
The credits roll.
A glowing figure sinks slowly, head first, into the deep.
Yukari's face fades in beside it, looking back over her shoulder.
She turns away, eyes closed.
Inside her outline, a young girl with a school bag.
Junpei appears, grinning, a hand at his cap.
Faint pictures flicker inside his outline.
A man with a mustache, then Mitsuru.
Mitsuru's face, calm, her hair over one eye.
She turns away.
Akihiko appears, smiling.
Inside his outline, a girl with long wavy hair.
Fuuka appears, smiling softly.
Inside her outline, two girls in school uniforms.
Ken appears, smiling, in a hooded jacket.
Inside his outline, a small boy stands alone.
Koromaru appears, mouth open, ears up.
A large eye fills his outline.
Shinjiro appears, head bowed, a hand on his cap.
Aigis appears, gazing out.
Inside her outline, a boy in a dark school uniform stands by some steps.
The pictures fade. Only the glowing figure is left, sinking into darkness.
It fades to black.
